speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent start on risperidone and improved psychiatric symptoms, is your new movement disorder characterized by muscle stiffness, tremors, or involuntary movements like tardive dyskinesia? Also, have you noticed any other side effects like sedation or weight gain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of restlessness, fidgeting, and leg crossing you describe sound very much like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. Is this feeling of inner tension present all the time, and have you noticed any changes in your mood or anxiety levels?
